body:
### Problem

Hi,

I've implemented a custom statuscolumn that changes the color of the separator (|) when there are diagnostic messages on the current line.

However, when I enable hlsearch (for example, by searching for `lua` here), the highlighting breaks whenever the width of the statuscolumn changes — for example, when the line number increases by one digit and the statuscolumn triggers a redraw/re-render. 

I'm not sure whether there's something wrong with my statuscolumn implementation or if this is expected behavior.

(video: every line includes at least the string `lua` once)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9860b4c-2418-4d0b-b9b6-c5e7a081cdb1





### Steps to reproduce


```lua
-- init.lua
-- clean nvim config. (rm -rf ~/.local/share/nvim ~/.local/state/nvim)
-- nothing except this

vim.opt.number         = false
vim.opt.relativenumber = true

function _G.statuscol_separator()
    local diagnostics = vim.diagnostic.get(0, { lnum = vim.v.lnum - 1 })
    if #diagnostics == 0 then return "│ " end

    local severity = vim.diagnostic.severity.HINT
    for _, diagnostic in ipairs(diagnostics) do
        severity = math.min(severity, diagnostic.severity)
    end

    local hl = ({
        [vim.diagnostic.severity.ERROR] = "DiagnosticSignError",
        [vim.diagnostic.severity.WARN]  = "DiagnosticSignWarn",
        [vim.diagnostic.severity.INFO]  = "DiagnosticSignInfo",
        [vim.diagnostic.severity.HINT]  = "DiagnosticSignHint",
    })[severity]
    return string.format("%%#%s#│%%* ", hl)
end

vim.opt.statuscolumn = [[%s%=%{v:relnum?v:relnum:v:lnum}%{%v:lua.statuscol_separator()%}]]

```

### Expected behavior

hlsearch shouldn't break

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

v0.13.0-dev-1471+gca992e82d4

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

not tested

### Operating system/version

7.1.6-400.asahi.fc44.aarch64+16k

### Terminal name/version

alacritty-0.17, ghostty-gh@master

### $TERM environment variable

alacritty

### Installation

github master

comment_data.body:
seems to be specific to alacritty with and without tmux
(alacritty-0.17.0-1 and also the latest master build).


Not reproduceable on xterm and kde-konsole

Can somebody help to debug this - maybe there is a term-sequence or escape sequence sent?

ghostty has an extremely good built-in "inspector", similar to firebug or chrome dev tools. Even if you don't use ghostty, it can be used to see the sequences that occur.

but this doesn't seem related to terminal sequences.

I build the current master of ghostty with --release=safe and the bug occures here too.

The log says... but I'm not sure if this is releated to the bug. It's just the output when ghostty is strated from a shell.
```log
warning(stream): ignoring unimplemented CSI p with intermediates: >
```

Your repro, but simplified:

```
nvim --noplugin -u repro.lua test.txt
```

```lua
-- repro.lua
vim.api.nvim_input("/+0300<Enter>:80<Enter>:100<Enter>")
vim.opt.relativenumber = true
vim.opt.statuscolumn = [[%{v:lnum}%#any-hl#x ]]
```
